## Family-Friendly Dinner Options in Barcelona for 2025-07-18

Best fit for a family of 4 at **19:30** with a **EUR 120 total budget**, plus **vegetarian options** and **outdoor seating**. I prioritized budget fit, family amenities, rating, and walking distance.

## Ranked Restaurant Comparison

| Rank | Restaurant | Cuisine | Est. Total | Rating | Walk | Vegetarian | Outdoor | Kids Menu | Fit |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | La Plaza | Spanish | EUR 118 | 4.7 | 20 min | Yes | Yes | Yes | Best overall balance |
| 2 | Casa Verde | Mediterranean | EUR 110 | 4.6 | 12 min | Yes | Yes | Yes | Strong all-rounder, closer |
| 3 | Green Fork | Vegan | EUR 105 | 4.5 | 18 min | Yes | Yes | Yes | Best if you want fully vegan-friendly |
| 4 | Tapa Feliz | Tapas | EUR 95 | 4.3 | 15 min | Yes | No | Yes | Good budget pick, but no outdoor seating |
| 5 | Mar y Sabor | Seafood | EUR 130 | 4.4 | 8 min | Limited | Yes | No | Fails budget and family filters |

## Simple Score Chart

Scoring basis: budget fit, family friendliness, vegetarian support, outdoor seating, rating, and distance.

| Restaurant | Score / 10 | Budget Fit | Family Features | Overall Read |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| La Plaza | 9.4 | Excellent | Excellent | Best match |
| Casa Verde | 9.2 | Excellent | Excellent | Very close second |
| Green Fork | 8.8 | Excellent | Excellent | Best specialty option |
| Tapa Feliz | 7.4 | Excellent | Good | Trade-off on outdoor seating |
| Mar y Sabor | 5.8 | Poor | Mixed | Not recommended for this trip |

## Best Recommendation for This Dinner

**Recommended: La Plaza**

Why it wins:
- **Fits the budget** at EUR 118
- Has **vegetarian options**
- Has **outdoor seating**
- Has a **kids menu**
- Highest rating in the group at **4.7**
- Good family-friendly balance for a dinner outing

Trade-offs:
- **Longest walk** among the top options at **20 minutes**
- Slightly tighter budget margin than Casa Verde or Green Fork

### Best backup choices
- **Casa Verde**: Best if you want a **shorter walk** and nearly the same quality
- **Green Fork**: Best if you want the **safest vegetarian-first choice**
- **Tapa Feliz**: Best if you want to save money, but it **does not have outdoor seating**
